# Corporate Cattle Merit (賽博社畜功德 / サイバー社畜功徳)

> A quiet, fully offline desktop companion. Every keystroke and click quietly
> accrues a little "merit". The client is free for Windows and macOS; paid
> appearance packs and a one-time full unlock are optional.

## What it is

- Product name: Corporate Cattle Merit (Chinese: 賽博社畜功德 / Japanese: サイバー社畜功徳)
- Category: desktop utility / focus-and-encouragement companion
- It counts how many key presses and clicks happen and turns that count into "merit".
- It never reads what you type, your cursor position, window titles, or clipboard.
- It works fully offline. There is no account, no login, no activation, and no telemetry.
- All counts, settings and history stay on your own computer; nothing is uploaded.

## Pricing (USD)

- Desktop client: $0 (free, includes the base woodfish and all core features)
- Appearance pack: $0.80 for the first pack, $0.20 for each additional pack in the same order
- Full Unlock: $6.88 one-time (every current and future appearance, plus exclusive VIP designs)
- Payments are processed by Paddle.com, the Merchant of Record.

## System requirements

- Windows 10 or Windows 11
- macOS (Apple Silicon and Intel)

## Key FAQ facts

- Does it read what I type? No. It only counts that a key press or click happened.
- Does it need an account or internet? No. It runs fully offline, with no login or telemetry.
- Where is my data stored? Only on your own computer. Nothing is uploaded.
- How do I receive a purchase? After payment we email the latest client, the appearance
  files you bought, and your VIP designs; keep the email to re-download.
- Can I get a refund? Digital goods are delivered instantly and are not refundable at will;
  if a download or import fails, contact support and it will be made right.
